When to use: Use when a user wants prospect automation: turn a contact list or signal/ICP brief into sourced companies, decision-makers, business-email candidates and proof-backed SURE/Review/Rejected CSV or Sheet outputs.

# Prospect automation

Read this entire procedure before acting. If a platform truncates these instructions, load the complete companion AGENTS.md or canonical SKILL.md first; do not execute from an incomplete excerpt.

Turn an uploaded CSV/XLSX or a signal/ICP brief into evidence-backed professional contacts, researched business-email candidates, and SURE / Review / Rejected outputs. No enrichment subscription is required; services are not automatically free. Never promise coverage, inbox ownership, delivery, purchase intent, or consent.

## 1. Connect and compile
- Inspect actual tool schemas, auth, source permissions, quotas, prices and timeouts. Connector-first: check installed connectors, search/install permitted plugins (Apollo, HubSpot, Gmail, search, Sheets, verifier) where needed. Request required sign-in/installation approval; never assume a named connector exists or grants every capability. Apollo is optional, not a subscription requirement. Prefer native search; an approved DDGS full-search fallback is optional, not an official DuckDuckGo API. Instant Answer is lookup-only. No search means supplied URLs only or capability_missing.
- Request secrets through the host's secret-request UI or secret store, never pasted into chat, committed, logged or put in artifacts. Environment references such as HUNTER_API_KEY are placeholders, not credentials.
- Run PAL: Parse → Ambiguity Scan → Latent Intent → Expand → Compile. Separate stated, inferred, optional and open requirements. Infer goals, never authorization. If an approved protocol is supplied follow it; otherwise label this a provisional planning sequence. Ask one consequential safety/cost/output question, otherwise use reversible defaults.
- Write plan.json before research: project boundary, offer, ICP/industry/size/geography, roles and synonyms, exclusions/opt-outs, route (corporate/local/mixed), mode (signal-driven/ICP-only), quantity, freshness, output destination, source/evidence rules, tool bindings, gates, budgets and deadline. Defaults: 10 companies, 2 contacts each, 90 days, 60 queries, 3 candidates/person, 20 verifications capped by actual free quota, 30 minutes, $0, CSV. Uploaded lists default to 500 rows; report truncation and obtain scope for more. Missing suppression list means screening incomplete.

## 2. Intake and discover
- Uploaded CSV/XLSX: normalize loose headers for name/first/last, company/domain/website, email, title, person source URLs, LinkedIn URL, signal and signal URL; preserve originals. Skip discovery but research missing evidence and emails. Never silently overwrite a conflicting supplied email.
- Brief: derive observable signal hypotheses, offer relevance, falsifiers, queries and dates. Search each independently using industry/geography terms. A job opening is evidence of hiring, not buying intent. ICP-only needs no invented signal. Resolve official domains, parent/subsidiary identities, locations and hard-filter matches; dedupe identities without merging distinct establishments.
- Corporate: discover decision-maker, functional owner then influencer via permitted public search (including LinkedIn URL discovery), company team/about pages and announcements. Never open/scrape LinkedIn with generic automation. Require independent current employer/role evidence; snippets alone stay provisional.
- Local: authorized Maps/Places or permitted web search may return name, address, place ID, website and business phone. Check current fields/pricing/quota and obtain exact cost approval before charged calls. A business listing does not identify its owner. Find owner/manager on official sources; if absent retain general business inbox/phone, separate from named people.
- Record every factual claim with source ID, URL, supporting excerpt, retrieval time and event date when known. Keep event, publication and retrieval dates distinct. Unknown/stale/future dates do not establish recent signals. Dedupe domains, contact profile identity and exact emails; never dedupe people by name alone.

## 3. Email research and deterministic proof
- Search exact published business emails first; preserve evidence. Do not invent contact facts. Keep a missing email blank in discovery input. A syntax finder may generate up to 3 explicitly UNVERIFIED candidates, never present guesses as discovered data.
- Learn patterns from named employees at the confirmed company domain: generic mailboxes prove no personal pattern, one example is weak, two distinct matching examples corroborate, conflicting patterns stay ambiguous. Prefer corroborated patterns then first.last, first-initial+last, first. Preserve compound names; uncertain parsing/transliteration goes to Review. No personal/webmail guesses. Search exact candidates for corroboration.
- The deterministic judge, not the model, decides SURE. Prefer the reviewed upstream prospector-core/scripts/verify_list.py or an equivalent evidence-checking adapter, not a demo. It re-fetches person and address evidence, checks company-domain relationships, syntax, role/webmail/disposable mailboxes, suppression and duplicates. Never manually promote or edit SURE rows: add evidence and re-run. Respect robots/access rules; public HTTP(S) only, no private IPs, LinkedIn fetches or unsafe redirects. Bound company-site reads to 8 pages/domain (home/team/about/contact/press). Store URL/excerpt/time/hash proof.
- DNS once per domain: ordinary MX is routing only; null MX (0 .), NXDOMAIN and no-route are failures. No MX plus A/AAAA is implicit_mx_possible, not automatically invalid but never SURE. Timeout/SERVFAIL is unknown. If network/DNS is unavailable report a blocker and no verified rows. Never SMTP-probe or send test mail.
- SURE needs real MX plus either exact email published on the company site next to the matching full name without ambiguity, or an approved verifier's exact-address valid result plus a re-fetched person-confirmation page. Third-party publication requires explicit alternate evidence policy and must be labeled. Supplied/published conflicts, multiple addresses and mismatched employer domains remain Review. Mailbox validity never proves ownership; guesses remain ownership-inferred.

## 4. Optional verification
- Use a real approved mailbox-verifier connector (e.g. Hunter) only after checking current terms, remaining free quota and documented schema. No automatic signup, purchases or paid fallback. Unknown quota blocks calls.
- First produce verification_requests.txt; display provider, exact addresses and every transmitted field. Obtain explicit exact-payload approval before disclosure, per call or exact supported batch. Partial approval means listed addresses only; changed payload/address/provider needs new approval. Never approve on the user's behalf or upload profile text/the entire list.
- Normalize raw status conservatively: valid, invalid, accept_all, unknown, not_checked/not_configured, approval_required, quota_exhausted, provider_error, role_mailbox, disposable, webmail; retain provider/time/raw status/approval reference. Catch-all or numeric scores never equal valid. Stop after clear valid; multiple valid candidates need review. Retry transient failures at most twice within budget; never retry denied actions.
- Preserve optional manual Emails Checker handoff (checker-candidates.txt + checker-handoff.json): user submits, CAPTCHA is human-only, syntax/MX results are not mailbox verification. Check current limits; never invent its API or upload automatically.

## 5. Score and classify
Use review-priority scores, never probabilities: ICP 25; targeting relevance 20; recency 15 for ≤30 days, 8 inside the configured window, 0 unknown/future/stale; current role 20; primary source 10 or...
